## Catalyst Bench Notes

Batch **B-17** showed _unexpected_ uptake after replacing MnO<sub>2</sub> with Fe<sup>3+</sup>; the earlier reading of ~~41.8%~~ was corrected to ***38.6%*** after recalibration.

Final remark: keep the <u>sealed vial</u> at 5<sup>o</sup>C and label the control as H<sub>2</sub>O.

issues.description: Underline formatting on "sealed vial" was lost. In GFM this could be preserved with inline HTML, e.g. `<u>sealed vial</u>`.
Bold+italic formatting for "38.6%" is represented as `**_38.6%_**` instead of the cleaner equivalent `***38.6%***`. Fidelity is preserved, but the Markdown is less clean than ideal.
